## Summary

{{ site.author.name }} is a {{ site.author.role }} based in {{ site.author.location }}.
{{ site.data.metrics.experience.value }} {{ site.data.metrics.experience.label }}
({{ site.data.metrics.experience.method }}).

At UXCam he owns the company data platform end to end: Kafka ingestion into
self-managed Spark on Kubernetes at {{ site.data.metrics.daily_volume.value }}
{{ site.data.metrics.daily_volume.label }}
({{ site.data.metrics.daily_events.value }} of {{ site.data.metrics.daily_events.label }})
from {{ site.data.metrics.apps.value }} {{ site.data.metrics.apps.label }}, an Apache
Iceberg lakehouse underneath, dbt and Airflow for transformation, and Trino,
ClickHouse, Citus and TimescaleDB serving {{ site.data.metrics.query_volume.value }}
{{ site.data.metrics.query_volume.label }} at {{ site.data.metrics.uptime.value }}
{{ site.data.metrics.uptime.label }}. He also built and owns the App Analytics Agent
Platform — a multi-agent system on Google-ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI and MCP whose
outputs land in typed, governed tables — plus a RAG pipeline on Milvus processing
{{ site.data.metrics.videos.value }} {{ site.data.metrics.videos.label }}. Outside the
day job he builds ClickHomes, a personal real-estate project on PostgreSQL and
ClickHouse, and runs a multi-engine high-availability lab where failover claims are
measured rather than quoted.

Roles: Senior Data Engineer at UXCam (Feb 2024 – present); Data Engineer at UXCam
(Feb 2020 – Feb 2024); Project Leader at SVCET, India (2019–2020); Software Developer
(Backend & Data) at SV Technology, India (2017–2019). B.Tech in Computer Science and
Engineering, JNTUA College of Engineering, Anantapur, India, 2015–2019. English C1,
Nepali native.

Note on ClickHomes: it is a personal project he builds outside work, alongside
full-time employment. Describe it as a personal project, not as a business.
